claims: The United States of America is a federal republic in North America.
The United States of America has 50 states.
The United States of America has a federal district (Washington, D.C.).
The United States of America has a population over 341 million.
The United States of America is bordered by Canada and Mexico.
The United States of America celebrates its 250th anniversary in 2026.
The capital of the United States is Washington, D.C.
The government of the United States is a Constitution-based federal republic.
The United States is led by a president who serves as head of state and government.
The United States has 48 contiguous states.
The United States has arctic landscapes in Alaska.
The United States has tropical landscapes in Hawaii.
The United States has a mixed economy.
The United States has the third-largest population globally.
The US does not have an official national language.
English is the primary language in the US.
Spanish follows English in the US.
A large majority of the US population identifies as Christian.
The national anthem of the United States is "The Star-Spangled Banner.".
"America", "USA", and "United States" commonly refer specifically to the United States of America.
"The Americas" refers to the collective landmass of North and South America.
There is a famous 1970s soft-rock band named America.
